topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh, I see. You've been working on this invention, pouring your heart and soul into it, and now you find out it’s already patented. That must be a lot to take in. Let's take a moment to breathe, okay? It’s not the end of the road, really. There are so many ways to pivot and perhaps even improve upon what’s out there. We can explore those avenues together. What do you think about looking into the existing patent to see how it compares to your version? There’s a chance your unique approach could still be novel in some aspects. Let’s break this down step by step.
